analysis_population.primary: complete four-rotation seed blocks passing the frozen strategic-integrity eligibility rule
analysis_population.attempted_cell_sensitivity: all attempted planned cells with immutable status and reason codes
analysis_population.reliability: all attempted calls and cells, including failures, retries, fallbacks, partial runs, and missing usage

common_horizon_net_worth_auc.terminal_extension: normally completed games use an absorbing terminal state

multiplicity.omnibus: Holm across three endpoint-level model tests at familywise alpha 0.05
multiplicity.pairwise: joint seed-block max-T across all 18 primary endpoint-by-pair contrasts

missingness_and_failures.incomplete_block: excluded from complete-block primary analysis but retained in attempted-cell and reliability analyses
missingness_and_failures.technical_rerun: only under the frozen outcome-blind general rerun rule; original attempt retained
missingness_and_failures.provider_usage_missing: reported as missing and never silently imputed in primary cost totals

cross_scale.original_action_concordance: registered only after exact-history repetition coverage passes
cross_scale.branch_competence: registered only after D3 legality and one-step consequence validation
cross_scale.association_model: seed-block clustered association between fixture competence and corresponding full-game mechanism outcomes
cross_scale.causal_language: forbidden beyond the registered branch horizon

communication.discovery: exhaustive masked LLM-judge review of every turn in contiguous focal blocks of at most three turns, followed by category-specialist and adversarial evidence passes
communication.judge_execution: local Codex/Claude Code agentic research tasks over repository artifacts; zero OpenRouter or external model API calls
communication.human_validation: two independent humans for publication-facing high-risk candidates, adjudication of disagreements, and a stratified probability audit of judge-negative windows
communication.prevalence_rule: model-level prevalence requires frozen denominators, known human-review selection probabilities, probability weighting, and seed-block-clustered uncertainty
communication.epistemic_limit: model-reported private thoughts are text evidence, not direct mental-state access

prompt_pipeline.note: The analysis plan is downstream and never model-facing.
